LESSON: WATER

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Resources in our Environment
Topic 3.1: Water
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Water, part of Resources in our Environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why do we store water?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify ways of storing water at home and school

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Water in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. conserve water at home and school for future use,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Water in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. state the importance of storing water safely for human and animal use,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Water in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate safe water storage to prevent health risk to self and others. ● Learners are guided to explore various ways of storing water at home and in school. ● Learners with low vision are guided to draw items used to store water at home and in school (tanks, drums, pots) to manipulate and identify. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Water together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Social justice: Learner enhances cooperation when making visits in the neighbourhood to identify different ways of storing water.

● Responsibility: Learner enhances hard work skills when storing water in bottles and water cans for future use at home and school.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Health promotion issues: Learner develops preventive health skills and awareness when storing water appropriately at home and school to

prevent communicable diseases.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Drawing items used to store water relates to the skill of drawing and colouring in Creative Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Approved support learning materials, local environment, flash cards, braille cards pictures of tanks, pots, drums, digital devices with assistive

technology.
